checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/sui-protocol and extract exact in-scope Move packages, repos, and exclusions
Clone the official Sui git repo at the commit/tag listed in scope
Run agents/external_audit.py against the scoped Move modules and dependencies
Review tool output for capability leaks, missing ownership checks, and type-safety violations
Manually inspect business logic around token transfers, staking, and object ownership
Check for oracle or cross-module trust assumptions that could be abused
Validate any findings with targeted Move unit tests or sui-prover assertions
Draft submission containing reproduction steps, affected commit, and severity justification
Submit report through the Hackenproof platform following their exact disclosure rules
Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the Sui Protocol bug bounty program directly on the Hackenproof website to ensure accuracy and avoid any potential misunderstandings.
Fetch the latest source code from the Sui Protocol's official GitHub repository to prepare for auditing.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the fetched Move code to perform source fetch, Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification where applicable, and frontier-LLM review.
Analyze the audit results from agents/external_audit.py to identify potential vulnerabilities and areas that require manual review.
Manually review the code against a real vulnerability taxonomy, checking for issues such as access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic flaws.
Use the results from the automated audit and manual review to identify and document potential vulnerabilities, including steps to reproduce and proposed fixes.
Check the Hackenproof website for specific submission guidelines, including required information and formatting for bug reports.

Submit the documented vulnerabilities to the Sui Protocol bug bounty program through the Hackenproof platform, ensuring that all required information is included and the submission meets the program's guidelines.
Monitor the submission status and respond to any follow-up questions or requests for additional information from the Sui Protocol team or Hackenproof.
